تقصون (form I)
# تَقُصُّونَ (taquṣṣūna) /ta.qusˤ.sˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of قَصَّ (qaṣṣa)
# تُقَصُّونَ (tuqaṣṣūna) /tu.qasˤ.sˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of قَصَّ (qaṣṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
